messages:
alex_infra: Quick deep-dive — I’m seeing ~17% variance between our committed GPU runrate and actual consumed GPU-hours over the last 7d. APAC embeddings bursts look like the main culprit, and cloud billing shows a small reconciliation glitch for reserved discounts. Sharing numbers + asking for short-term mitigations.

priya_eng: Can you paste the numbers & query you used? also, any obvious tenants driving the spikes?

alex_infra: High-level: committed = 320 A100-equivalent GPUs (monthly commit). 7d avg-concurrent = 265. 95p hourly spike = 380 (sustained on 3 separate days for 2–6h). 
Top drivers: partner-batch embeddings (s3 -> batch -> host) + occasional rerank retrains.
Query I ran: ```sql
SELECT hour, sum(gpu_hours) as gpu_hours, sum(committed_hours) as committed_hours
FROM infra.billing_usage
WHERE region = 'apac' AND date >= current_date - interval '7' day
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour;
```

kevin_finance: I pulled invoices — reserved discount reconciliation didn't apply to ~8% of usage in APAC for two billing runs (looks like tag mismatch). That inflated billed on-demand line by ~$12k this month. Filing a ticket with cloud billing.

sophie_sre: For immediate risk: if spikes continue we risk breaching reserved capacity and degrading latency SLAs (esp chat endpoints). Do we have buffer in Dedicated pool to borrow?

alex_infra: Dedicated pool has ~20 GPUs headroom in eu-west but APAC pool is pinned to commit. Short-term options: 1) throttle batch embedding concurrency per partner, 2) enable routing to lower-cost g5-style instances for non-latency-critical embeddings, 3) pre-emptible spot mix for batch windows, 4) buy short-term burst credits from cloud marketplace if available.

priya_eng: Throttling looks fastest. I can add per-tenant concurrency caps and stagger job starts. Will push a change to the batch scheduler; patch ready in ~90m.

alex_infra: Thanks — please add a flag to force-run small batches (<=128 items) to prefer lower-cost pools. Also add a telemetry tag so we can separate commit-eligible vs non-commit usage.

sophie_sre: I can open a temporary routing rule to send embeddings with tag `nonlatency=batch` to the eu-west spill pool during APAC peak window (00:00-06:00 UTC). That will preserve chat SLOs.

capacity-bot: [automated] APAC GPU usage spike detected: peak 380 GPUs @ 2816069800. 7d avg 265. Alert set: variance > 12% vs commit. See dashboard: https://redwood.example/dashboards/gpu-variance?range=7d

kevin_finance: Billing ticket #CB-4821 opened with provider — asked them to reapply reserved discounts for usage tagged `redwood:commit`. They acknowledged and gave ETA 48h. If they don't fix, we should consider an internal credit before month-close.

alex_infra: Medium-term ask (<2 weeks): run a commitment-sizing reforecast that accounts for 95p spike hours and new embeddings customer growth. If we add 40 GPUs to commit we reduce overage but increase monthly baseline by ~$XXk. Need CFO signoff.

kevin_finance: I'll model the delta. Quick calc: add 40 A100-eq -> +12% commit cost but reduces on-demand overage given current spike pattern. I'll drop a sensitivity sheet by EOD.

priya_eng: Patch notes (will deploy in 90m): - per-tenant concurrency default 8 -> 3 for heavy partners - small-batch routing to spill pools - add telemetry tag `commit_candidate=true/false`

sophie_sre: Ops steps I’ll run after deploy: 1) enable routing rule, 2) monitor latency SLOs for chat endpoints, 3) have rollback plan to revert routing in 15m if error rate > 1%.

alex_infra: Runbook (short):
- T+0: Priya deploys throttle + tagging (90m)
- T+2h: Sophie enables APAC->eu-west spill routing during peak window
- T+24h: Re-evaluate 7d variance; if >10% still, exec finance model for +40 commit
- T+48h: Follow-up on billing ticket, apply internal credit if provider doesn't reconcile

priya_eng: Added PR: `infra/batch-scheduler: add-per-tenant-throttle` — link: https://phabricator.redwood/PR/7593

kevin_finance: Sent initial sensitivity model to execs (sheet link in email). Tagging @cfo for +40 GPU ask if needed.

alex_infra: Thanks all. Two asks before we close thread: Sophie — confirm monitoring runbook entries and alert thresholds. Kevin — please include breakeven calc (how many overage hours/month justify commit add). Priya — post-deploy telemetry ping in this thread.

priya_eng: Will ping here after 1st deploy and share initial telemetry.

sophie_sre: Monitoring updated: added alert `gpu_commit_gap` (trigger if variance > 10% for 24h) and dashboard panel for commit-eligible vs spill usage.

capacity-bot: [automated] Follow-up: 24h delta post-mitigation expected. Next scheduled summary @ 2816165600.

alex_infra: Closing loop for now — we'll reconvene in 24h unless any of you see a regression. :thumbsup:
